കളം (pronounced kalam) is a sleek web app for managing checklists directly from Google Sheets. It connects to a shared spreadsheet and provides a beautiful, collapsible interface for activity tracking — ideal for outreach teams, clubs, or any collaborative workflows. Live at kalam-beta.vercel.app.

✨ Features

  • Interactive checklist UI synced with Google Sheets
  • Role-based edit access — add [!] to an activity's name to make it uneditable
  • Collapsible activity groups for better UX

🧠 Tech stack

  • React + TypeScript
  • Google Sheets API v4
  • Google OAuth2 (token-based login)
  • Tailwind CSS for styling
  • Lucide React for icons

Released under the MIT License — feel free to fork, remix, and use.
